summary: Dispute over specific performance of an oral agreement for sale of property dated 11.11.2002, with advance payment of Rs.10,001/- and balance Rs.15 lakhs pending. Respondent claimed readiness to pay; Appellants denied existence of agreement and challenged proof of continuous readiness. Trial Court and High Court upheld agreement and granted specific performance. Issue before Supreme Court: whether Respondent proved continuous readiness and willingness under Section 16(c) of Specific Relief Act, 1963. Courts below relied on oral testimony and deposit of balance amount. Appellants argued lack of evidence on financial capacity and changed property values.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed. Concurrent findings of Trial Court and High Court on readiness and willingness upheld. Specific performance granted; sale deed to be executed upon receipt of balance consideration.
